class Fabric:
    """Precomputed calendar, drift rates, anchors, blackouts and circuits."""

    def __init__(self, fabric, cal):
        self.fabric = fabric
        self.cal = cal
        self.N = int(fabric['n'])
        self.T = int(fabric['interval_ns'])
        self.S = int(fabric['slice_ns'])
        self.O = int(fabric['offset_ns'])
        self.slices = [[int(x) for x in sl] for sl in fabric['slices']]
        self.slice_set = [set(sl) for sl in self.slices]
        self.Q = len(self.slices)
        self.P = period_rounds(self.T, self.S, self.Q)
        self.drift = [int(x) for x in fabric['drift_ppb']]
        self.guards = [int(g) for g in fabric['guards_ns']]
        self.reconfig_ns = int(fabric['reconfig_ns'])
        self.links = fabric['links']
        self.nlinks = len(self.links)
        P, N = self.P, self.N

        # phase calendar: slice index and offset inside the slice
        self.slice_of = [0] * P
        self.rho = [0] * P
        for p in range(P):
            sl, pos = utils.slice_position(p, self.T, self.S, self.O, self.Q)
            self.slice_of[p] = sl
            self.rho[p] = pos

        # effective residual drift rate per phase and device
        rate = np.tile(np.array(self.drift, dtype=np.int64), (P, 1))
        for rec in fabric['heat']:
            node = int(rec[0]); start = int(rec[1]); end = int(rec[2]); extra = int(rec[3])
            start = max(0, min(start, P)); end = max(0, min(end, P))
            if end > start:
                rate[start:end, node] += extra
        self.rate_np = rate
        self.rate = rate.tolist()
        self.drift_allow = [[self.rate[p][i] * self.T for i in range(N)] for p in range(P)]

        # prefix sums of the drift allowance over the period (for ageing)
        acc = np.zeros((P + 1, N), dtype=np.int64)
        acc[1:] = np.cumsum(rate, axis=0) * self.T
        total = acc[P]
        self.pref2 = np.concatenate([acc, acc[1:] + total], axis=0)
        self.total = total.tolist()

        # anchors: which devices are exact at every phase
        mask = np.zeros((P, N), dtype=bool)
        for rec in fabric['anchors']:
            node = int(rec[0]); start = int(rec[1]); end = int(rec[2])
            start = max(0, min(start, P)); end = max(0, min(end, P))
            if end > start:
                mask[start:end, node] = True
        self.anchor_nodes = [[int(x) for x in np.nonzero(mask[p])[0]] for p in range(P)]

        # blackouts per link, as a phase mask
        bmask = np.zeros((self.nlinks, P), dtype=bool)
        for rec in fabric['blackouts']:
            lid = int(rec[0]); start = int(rec[1]); end = int(rec[2])
            start = max(0, min(start, P)); end = max(0, min(end, P))
            if end > start:
                bmask[lid, start:end] = True
        self.blackout = [bytearray(row.tobytes()) for row in bmask]

        # per directed link code: hop allowance and minimax correction
        self.allow_by_code = [0] * (2 * self.nlinks)
        self.corr_by_code = [0] * (2 * self.nlinks)
        for lid, link in enumerate(self.links):
            e0 = link['ends'][0]; e1 = link['ends'][1]
            for direction in (0, 1):
                if direction == 0:
                    a, b = int(e0[2]), int(e1[2])
                else:
                    a, b = int(e1[2]), int(e0[2])
                self.allow_by_code[2 * lid + direction] = cal.hop_allowance(a, b)
                self.corr_by_code[2 * lid + direction] = cal.hop_correction(a, b)

        self.edges = self._build_edges()

    # -- helpers ----------------------------------------------------------
    def blocked(self, lid, phase, delay):
        """True when the physical flight of ``delay`` ns hits a blackout."""
        bl = self.blackout[lid]
        P = self.P
        last = phase + (delay - 1) // self.T
        q = phase
        while q <= last:
            if bl[q % P]:
                return True
            q += 1
        return False

    def ageing(self, phase, dst, x1, delta):
        """Receiver drift allowance between physical reception and application.

        ``x1`` is the offset (ns after the sending boundary) of the physical
        reception and ``delta`` the number of boundaries until the application.
        """
        T = self.T
        P = self.P
        m1, r1 = divmod(x1, T)
        if r1:
            out = (T - r1) * self.rate[(phase + m1) % P][dst]
            m_start = m1 + 1
        else:
            out = 0
            m_start = m1
        k = delta - m_start
        if k <= 0:
            return out
        q, r = divmod(k, P)
        pf = self.pref2
        start = (phase + m_start) % P
        out += q * self.total[dst] + int(pf[start + r][dst]) - int(pf[start][dst])
        return out
